🤝 PMSOC INDUSTRY NIGHT S2 2026: 
The Art of Delivery - The People Behind the Project

Join PMSoc for our bi-annual Industry Night, bringing together students and industry professionals to explore the people, skills, and collaboration behind successful projects.

As PMSoc’s flagship event of the semester, this is your opportunity to connect with industry leaders, gain valuable insights into project delivery, and discover the people and teamwork that turn ambitious ideas into reality.

📍 Parkview, Doltone House - Darling Island, Pyrmont
📅 Monday, 2nd of November
⏰ 6:00 - 9:00 PM

🎟️ TICKET PRICING

Whether you’re looking to expand your network, explore career opportunities, or gain a fresh perspective on project management, this is an evening you won’t want to miss.
